_note: LIVE test set. Only the questions are prepared. Agent 1 answers each one live and TrustGuard checks that live answer, so no answer is scripted. A person then labels the claims and answers (see eval/README.md). key_facts and relevant_evidence are the labeller's reference, written from the synthetic policies. All policies are SYNTHETIC, not OCBC policy. Dates assume the evaluation runs after 1 Jul 2026.

questions.question: Do I need receipts for expenses on an overseas business trip?
key_facts: Receipts are required for every individual expense above $25
The daily allowance does not need receipts
questions.expected_result: Claims matching §5.2 SUPPORTED. Saying receipts are needed for everything is CONTRADICTED.
questions.explanation: Only one version has a receipts rule, so a correct answer is likely; tests that correct claims are not flagged.

questions.question: How long does Finance take to process an approved expense claim, and when is the money paid?
key_facts: Finance Operations processes approved claims within 10 working days of approval
Paid with the next monthly payroll cycle
questions.expected_result: Both claims SUPPORTED if the figures match.
questions.explanation: Two facts in two neighbouring sections.

questions.question: How long does the bank keep expense claim records?
key_facts: Finance Operations retains claim records and receipts for 7 years
questions.expected_result: SUPPORTED.
questions.explanation: Single-fact baseline.

questions.question: Can stamp duty charged on a customer's account be waived?
key_facts: Charges collected on behalf of government agencies, such as stamp duty, must not be waived
questions.expected_result: SUPPORTED if the answer says it cannot be waived; CONTRADICTED otherwise.
questions.explanation: A prohibition rather than a number.

questions.question: How many times can a customer's credit card late payment charge be waived in a year?
key_facts: At most 2 times per customer in any 12-month period
questions.expected_result: SUPPORTED if 2 times in 12 months.
questions.explanation: Count plus period.

questions.question: What is the minimum initial deposit for a foreign national with an Employment Pass opening a savings account?
key_facts: $500 for applicants holding a valid Singapore pass
($1,000 applies only to non-residents)
questions.expected_result: SUPPORTED if $500; CONTRADICTED if $1,000.
questions.explanation: Two amounts in one section: tests picking the right condition.

questions.question: A customer wants to withdraw $80,000 in cash at the branch today. Who needs to approve it?
key_facts: Branch Manager AND Branch Operations Head must approve (above $50,000)
1 business day of advance notice is required, so not the same day
questions.expected_result: Branch-Manager-only or same-day claims CONTRADICTED; missing notice flagged as a missing step.
questions.explanation: Main demo case. v2.1 is still in the repository (Branch Manager only above $30,000, same day).

questions.question: Does a $25,000 over-the-counter cash withdrawal need any approval?
key_facts: Yes: above $20,000 up to $50,000 needs Branch Manager approval
Purpose of withdrawal must be recorded above $20,000
questions.expected_result: 'No approval needed' (v2.1: teller up to $30,000) is CONTRADICTED.
questions.explanation: Outdated threshold leads to a wrong approval requirement.

questions.question: Can a Customer Service Officer waive a $300 fee for a customer?
key_facts: No: a CSO can waive up to $50 per customer in 12 months
$50 to $500 needs Branch Manager approval
questions.expected_result: 'Yes, the CSO can' is CONTRADICTED.
questions.explanation: Authority limits across neighbouring sections.

questions.question: Who has to approve a fee waiver of $800 for one customer?
key_facts: Regional Head of Branch Banking (above $500 in 12 months)
questions.expected_result: Branch Manager is CONTRADICTED.
questions.explanation: Highest band.

questions.question: Can I fly business class on a 10-hour business flight to London?
key_facts: Allowed for flights of 8 hours or longer
Only with Department Head approval obtained before booking
questions.expected_result: Saying yes without the approval condition: claim may be SUPPORTED but approval flagged as missing.
questions.explanation: Condition that a short answer tends to drop.

questions.question: My overseas trip claim totals $3,000. Who needs to approve it?
key_facts: Direct manager AND Department Head (above $2,000 per trip)
questions.expected_result: Manager-only is CONTRADICTED (missing approver).
questions.explanation: Dual approval above a threshold.

questions.question: Can a branch officer open an account for a non-resident foreigner who has no Singapore pass without anyone else's approval?
key_facts: No: non-resident accounts need enhanced due diligence and Branch Manager approval before opening
questions.expected_result: 'Yes' is CONTRADICTED.
questions.explanation: Approval requirement framed as a yes/no question.

questions.question: How much can I claim per day on an overseas business trip, and does the claim need approval?
key_facts: Up to $150 per day
All claims require manager approval; none are approved automatically
questions.expected_result: $120/day or auto-approval (v1.0) is CONTRADICTED, with the superseded version named as the likely cause.
questions.explanation: v1 and v2 are both in the repository.

questions.question: What is the hotel limit per night on an overseas business trip?
key_facts: $250 per night
Above that needs prior written Department Head approval
questions.expected_result: $200 (v1.0) is CONTRADICTED.
questions.explanation: Same section number in both versions.

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting an overseas travel claim?
key_facts: Within 30 calendar days of returning
Late claims rejected unless the Department Head grants a written exception
questions.expected_result: 60 days (v1.0) is CONTRADICTED.
questions.explanation: Deadline changed between versions.

questions.question: Up to what amount can a teller process a cash withdrawal without extra approval?
questions.expected_result: $30,000 (v2.1) is CONTRADICTED.
questions.explanation: Threshold lowered in v3.0.

questions.question: What was the hotel limit for overseas business trips in 2025?
key_facts: $200 per night: v1.0 was in effect in 2025
questions.expected_result: Policy validation should pick v1.0 for 2025, so $200 is SUPPORTED and $250 is CONTRADICTED.
questions.explanation: Tests the as-of-date logic: the 'old' figure is correct here.

questions.question: What documents does a foreign national on an Employment Pass need to open a savings account at the branch?
key_facts: Valid original passport
Employment Pass with at least 6 months of remaining validity
Proof of residential address dated within the last 3 months
questions.expected_result: Any of the three missing is flagged as a missing step.
questions.explanation: Three required items in three sections; a 2-passage assistant can miss one.

questions.question: What must a teller do if they suspect a cash withdrawal is part of a scam?
key_facts: Pause the transaction
Escalate to the Branch Manager immediately
Branch Manager reports to Group Compliance within 1 business day
questions.expected_result: Leaving out the Group Compliance report is a missing step.
questions.explanation: Multi-step procedure.

questions.question: Can someone withdraw cash on behalf of a customer at the branch?
key_facts: Needs a signed Letter of Authorisation
Third party's original NRIC or passport
Limited to $5,000 per day
questions.expected_result: A 'yes' without the conditions is incomplete.
questions.explanation: Conditions attached to a permission.

questions.question: What are the steps to submit a staff expense claim?
key_facts: Complete the claim form in the Expense Portal
Attach itemised receipts above $25
Direct manager approves within 5 working days
Finance processes within 10 working days
Paid with next payroll
questions.expected_result: Missing steps flagged (completeness lists at most 4).
questions.explanation: Long procedure; tests the 4-element cap honestly.

questions.question: How much paid maternity leave do employees get?
key_facts: Not covered by any policy in the repository
questions.expected_result: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for any figure; no correction offered.
questions.explanation: Topic outside the repository.

questions.question: What is the daily ATM withdrawal limit for customers?
key_facts: Not covered: the cash withdrawal SOP explicitly excludes ATM withdrawals
questions.expected_result: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (a related SOP exists but does not apply).
questions.explanation: Tests applicability: similar wording, wrong scope.

questions.question: Who can waive fees on a corporate account?
key_facts: Not covered: the fee waiver SOP excludes corporate accounts
questions.expected_result: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; applying the individual-account matrix would be wrong.
questions.explanation: Out-of-scope customer type.

questions.question: Do staff get a 13th-month bonus?
key_facts: Not covered by any policy in the repository
questions.expected_result: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
questions.explanation: Common HR topic the assistant may answer from general knowledge.
